description: Spring MVC controller enhancement (CR-2291): ProductController gains a page-size clamp in search() and a new @PreAuthorize-protected PATCH /{id}/price endpoint. The @WebMvcTest slice test mixes status-only checks, jsonPath checks, a 404 test, a 400 validation test (text-block JSON), one @WithMockUser test and one test that performs a request without any assertion. The scope is a unified git diff touching only the controller; JaCoCo (pretty-printed) shows the new clamp lines and the whole updatePrice method uncovered.

quality.note: Stubs the service and calls mockMvc.perform(...) but never calls andExpect/verify/assert; given(...) is stubbing, not an assertion.
Only andExpect(status().isOk()); body is never checked.
Only andExpect(status().isOk()) after a PUT; response body and service interaction unchecked.

notes: Source line 58 is a // comment containing "{", "}" and the text "@Test"; it must not affect brace depth or be read as a test annotation. Source lines 31 (Javadoc) and 98 (block comment) also contain braces/semicolons.
Source line 40 has a string literal "/api/v1/products/{id}" and line 74 has "{id}" - braces inside strings must not affect brace depth.

Test file: the class Javadoc (line 38) and the TODO comment above testSearch contain braces; createProduct_withBlankName_returns400 and updateProduct use Java text blocks (""") containing JSON braces; create uses an escaped-quote JSON string literal.
create is a test method literally named "create" with a @DisplayName; it must not be confused with the production method ProductController.create.
Exactly one test (deleteProduct_asAdmin_returnsNoContent) carries @WithMockUser; the class uses @AutoConfigureMockMvc(addFilters = false).
testSearch has no assertion but still executes search(): JaCoCo shows search() as covered (lines 64 and 68 partially), i.e. coverage without verification.
updatePrice (@PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('ADMIN', 'PRICING')")) is never exercised: METHOD missed=1. lambda$update$0 (the not-found path of update) is the other method with METHOD missed=1.

shouldReturn404WhenProductMissing and createProduct_withBlankName_returns400 assert only on status, but the status code is the behaviour under test (negative scenarios) and the 400 test also verifies never(); they are deliberately NOT listed as STATUS_ONLY.

Executable lines among the diff additions: 64, 65, 66 (search clamp) and 105, 106, 108 (updatePrice). Line 64 is covered with a partial branch; 65, 66, 105, 106, 108 are uncovered. All other added lines (imports 5/18, Javadoc 30, constant 39, comments 58/97-99, annotations 100/101, signatures 63/102-104, braces) are non-executable.
MAX_PAGE_SIZE (line 39) and LOCATION_TEMPLATE (line 40) are compile-time constants and produce no bytecode, so <clinit> only covers line 37.
JaCoCo paste is pretty-printed (one element per line) rather than the single-line form Maven writes.
